entries.title: A highway instead of a racetrack: Strong coupling of light and sound in an optical fiber
entries.summary: For the first time, scientists have achieved strong coupling between light and long-lived acoustic vibrations in an optical fiber. Optical fibers are used in both classical telecommunications and quantum communication and could serve not only as connections between computing…

entries.title: Infrared light overcomes mirror coating obstacle in gravitational wave detector upgrades
entries.summary: Researchers have developed and tested a new locking method for gravitational wave detectors that will advance the discovery of distant black holes and neutron stars colliding.

entries.title: World-record intensity in attosecond hard-X-ray pulses could unlock closer study of electrons in atoms and molecules
entries.summary: Researchers used the European XFEL to create X-ray flashes that were not only extremely short but also reached record intensity for this type of pulse. The researchers focused the X-rays to an area roughly 100,000 times smaller than the cross section of a typical human hair.…
